dose_adult.indication: Episódio depressivo do transtorno bipolar I (monoterapia ou adjuvante de lítio ou valproato)
dose_adult.note: Tomar com alimento (pelo menos 350 calorias). Na monoterapia, 80 a 120 mg/dia não trouxe eficácia adicional média sobre 20 a 60 mg/dia. Insuficiência renal ou hepática moderada/grave e inibidor moderado de CYP3A4 reduzem a dose máxima (seções 2.4 a 2.6).

cite.locator: seção 2.2 Depressive Episodes Associated with Bipolar I Disorder
cite.quote: The recommended starting dose of LATUDA is 20 mg given once daily as monotherapy or as adjunctive therapy with lithium or valproate. Initial dose titration is not required. LATUDA has been shown to be effective in a dose range of 20 mg per day to 120 mg per day as monotherapy or as adjunctive therapy with lithium or valproate
cite.note: Mesma seção: "The maximum recommended dose, as monotherapy or as adjunctive therapy with lithium or valproate, is 120 mg per day."

cite.locator: Boxed warning: Increased mortality in elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis
cite.quote: Elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis treated with antipsychotic drugs are at an increased risk of death.

cite.locator: Boxed warning: Suicidal thoughts and behaviors
cite.quote: Antidepressants increased the risk of suicidal thoughts and behavior in pediatric and young adults in short-term studies.

Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (e.g., ketoconazole, clarithromycin, ritonavir, voriconazole, mibefradil, etc.) [see Drug Interactions ( 7.1 )]. Strong CYP3A4 inducers (e.g., rifampin, avasimibe, St. John's wort, phenytoin, carbamazepine, etc.)
cite.note: Seção 2.6: com inibidor moderado de CYP3A4, reduzir a dose à metade (início de 20 mg e máximo de 80 mg/dia); evitar toranja (grapefruit); com indutor moderado pode ser preciso aumentar a dose.

cite.quote: If signs and symptoms of tardive dyskinesia appear in a patient on LATUDA, drug discontinuation should be considered.

Atypical antipsychotic drugs have been associated with metabolic changes that may increase cardiovascular/cerebrovascular risk. These metabolic changes include hyperglycemia, dyslipidemia, and body weight gain.
cite.note: Nos ensaios de curto prazo da própria bula, o ganho de peso médio com lurasidona foi pequeno (+0,29 kg na depressão bipolar em monoterapia).

cite.quote: As with other drugs that antagonize dopamine D 2 receptors, LATUDA elevates prolactin levels.
Leukopenia/neutropenia has been reported during treatment with antipsychotic agents. Agranulocytosis (including fatal cases) has been reported with other agents in the class.
cite.note: A agranulocitose é citada para outros antipsicóticos da classe, não especificamente para a lurasidona.

cite.quote: LATUDA may cause orthostatic hypotension and syncope, perhaps due to its α1-adrenergic receptor antagonism.
As with other antipsychotic drugs, LATUDA should be used cautiously in patients with a history of seizures or with conditions that lower the seizure threshold

cite.locator: seção 5.12 Potential for Cognitive and Motor Impairment
cite.quote: In short-term, placebo-controlled schizophrenia studies, somnolence was reported by 17.0% (256/1508) of patients treated with LATUDA
cite.note: Mesma seção: 7,1% com placebo. Na depressão bipolar: 7,3% (20 a 60 mg) e 13,8% (80 a 120 mg) em monoterapia contra 6,5% com placebo; 11,4% como adjuvante contra 5,1%.

cite.quote: Antidepressant treatment can increase the risk of developing a manic or hypomanic episode, particularly in patients with bipolar disorder. Monitor patients for the emergence of such episodes.
cite.note: Mesma seção: nos estudos de depressão bipolar em adultos, menos de 1% dos pacientes com lurasidona e com placebo tiveram episódio maníaco ou hipomaníaco.

cite.locator: seção 2.4 Dose Modifications for Renal Impairment
cite.quote: Dose adjustment is recommended in moderate (creatinine clearance: 30 to <50 mL/min) and severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance <30 mL/min) patients.
cite.note: Mesma seção: início de 20 mg/dia e máximo de 80 mg/dia.

cite.quote: Neonates exposed to antipsychotic drugs during the third trimester of pregnancy are at risk for extrapyramidal and/or withdrawal symptoms following delivery
cite.note: Mesma seção: não há estudos de lurasidona em gestantes.

cite.locator: Boxed warning: Suicidal thoughts and behaviors
cite.quote: Closely monitor all antidepressant-treated patients for clinical worsening, and for emergence of suicidal thoughts and behaviors
Weight gain has been observed with atypical antipsychotic use. Clinical monitoring of weight is recommended.
cite.note: Mesma seção: glicemia de jejum no início e periodicamente para quem tem fatores de risco para diabetes, e acompanhamento do controle glicêmico em quem já tem diabetes.

cite.locator: seção 6.1 Clinical Trials Experience (Bipolar Depression, Monotherapy)
cite.quote: The most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥5%, in either dose group, and at least twice the rate of placebo) in patients treated with LATUDA were akathisia, extrapyramidal symptoms, somnolence, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and anxiety.
cite.note: Mesma seção, adjuvante de lítio ou valproato: "The most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥5% and at least twice the rate of placebo) in subjects treated with LATUDA were akathisia and somnolence."

common_effects.note: Depressão bipolar em adultos, monoterapia. Ansiedade entra como nervosismo. Como adjuvante de lítio ou valproato, as mais comuns foram acatisia e sonolência.
